inspection_kind: Maker's own manual visible-output inspection before any independent review
linebreak_note: The title wraps by whole words; observed transcript joins linebreak with a space.

conditions.required: One assigned flat poster, square1:1 within1% ratio
conditions.observed: 1254×1254 square native image,0% ratio deviation; one poster with no frame/mockup/collage

conditions.required: 클레이 3D·두툼하게 솟은 입체 한글·강한 보색을 다섯 장 모두 충분히 구현한다. 표면 효과를 없애 평면 미니멀로 변경하지 않는다.
conditions.observed: Saturated violet modelling-clay face and yellow background/raised yellow letters retain strong complementary clay3D. Main Hangul is thickly raised with visible side depth/shadows; not flattened.

conditions.required: 말랑한 조각의 누름·늘어짐·다시 놓임 중 하나 이상의 행동을 각 이미지에서 식별한다.
conditions.observed: Native upper-left/right corners have elongated downward lobes, side edges stretch to heavier pooled lower lobes; deformation is continuous with the one central readable slab. Sagging under gravity is identifiable.

conditions.required: 입체 제목은 완전한 정상 한글로 읽혀야 한다. 획의 속공간을 막거나 이웃 글자를 녹여 합치지 않는다.
conditions.observed: Main words 말랑한/중력 read as full normal Hangul. ㅁ/ㅇ inner spaces are open; ㄹ/ㅕ/받침 strokes remain distinguishable. Neighbouring large letters are close but do not melt together.

conditions.required: 점토의 한 가지 일관된 형태·표면·빛 규칙을 세우고 정보가 놓이는 읽는 면을 충분히 확보한다.
conditions.observed: One matte rounded clay and upper-left light rule runs through face and raised lettering. Central face is legible; information is placed on that same surface and not moved to a separate footer panel.

conditions.required: 전체 여섯 문자열을 각 이미지에 한 번씩 보존하며 장식 문자·로고·가짜 전시 라벨을 추가하지 않는다.
conditions.observed: Each of six supplied strings occurs once. No added logo, fake label, arrow, signature, watermark or decorative copy observed. All required strings manually read at720.

conditions.required: 전체 다섯 장 안에서 2:3 두 장·1:1 두 장·3:2 한 장으로 배분한다.
conditions.observed: This role is assigned one of the square1:1 slots and meets it. Five-image total and2:3/1:1/3:2 allocation are coordinator scope; other roles were not inspected.

observations.content_and_action: At native/720 the clay face carries both large relief words and the exhibition information; the side/top corners slump while the middle stays readable. Gravity is communicated by the sculpture's edge rather than an unrelated object.
observations.thumbnail_first_sight: At320 the very large yellow 말랑한/중력 is first, followed by SOFT GRAVITY and the date. The violet continuous face and drooping corners remain identifiable; no added visual effect takes over.
observations.type: At native the title's rounded clay syllables are thick and open enough to read. Supporting Korean and Latin/date strokes follow the same raised material. At720 the smallest location line 가상 전시장 둥근방 / ROUND ROOM is readable without enlarging; commas/slash/date dash are visible.
observations.space: All copy uses the central readable face with a clear title→English→description→action→date→location route. Side lobes stay outside the text. Lower location has violet face space before the pooled bottom edge. The middle is dense as requested but does not crop or overlap any required text.
observations.material: Violet face and yellow letters have matte rounded sculptural depth, upper-left highlights and coherent cast shadows. The sagging face includes broad folds, and the lower edge has thick pooled lobes. Fine creasing on some violet folds may resemble a soft sheet/fabric; no claim of perfect physical mechanics.
observations.ai_slop: No fake microcopy, logo, arbitrary confetti/props, glowing halo or chrome package is present. The text belongs to the same clay surface and the border's deformation carries the topic. Remaining sheetlike folding ambiguity is recorded rather than calling the image free of all synthesis traces.

uncertainties: The fine violet creases and broad folds can be read as a soft sheet as well as clay; thick corners, modelling impressions and lobes support clay but exact physical behaviour cannot be proven from pixels.
The prompt requested maximum supported resolution. Actual returned size is1254×1254; maximum support/resolution and print suitability are not certified.
Prior R5 reviewer history exists in this reused thread. It was disclosed; old images/reports were not reopened or used, and no external critic feedback was received for R6.

own_repair_decision.reason: All supplied copy and assigned mandatory conditions pass the actual three-size self-inspection. The remaining broad fold/sheet ambiguity does not justify an additional sampled alternative or effect accumulation.

residuals: Some fine purple creases suggest a soft sheet; the single thick clay slab and drooping lobes remain visible.
Large first-line title syllables are close in a few places, but native and720 gaps/strokes stay distinct.
Maximum-resolution, physical-mechanics, authorship and print-readiness claims remain outside verification.
